question: How is the Sakala group completed and which ten Rudras are named next?
premises: The throat-and-lip member is said to be the eighth, completing the Sakala group.
The names Om, Kara, Shiva, Dipta, Hetu, Isha, Dashesha, Sushiva, and Kala begin the next list.
inference: The verse closes the Sakala eight and opens the list of ten Rudras.
uncertainties: The parsing of oṃkāraśivau and hetvīśadaśeśakau is compact; the name boundaries follow the transmitted compound.
plain_english: The throat-and-lip member is indeed the eighth, and this group of eight beginning with Sakala is taught. Then come Om, Kara, Shiva, Dipta, Hetu, Isha, Dashesha, Sushiva, and Kala.
